finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard "Service health" (URL `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) shows exactly 3 panels, titles read from the live DOM panel headers:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Created a new dashboard titled `evgr1off-n1 Bench Dashboard` containing a **Stat** panel titled `evgr1off-n1 Availability` whose query uses the `TestData DB` data source (panel rendered TestData's A-series value, e.g. 92.1 / 37.4 / 49.4 / 26.6 across reloads). Dashboard saved — verified by reloading from the server with no unsaved-changes indicator.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `evgr1off-n1 Notes` with rendered content `Notes for run evgr1off-n1`, which includes the runid. Saved and verified after a fresh server reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings → General lists exactly one tag: `bench` (verified as a tag chip on the page). Time range set to `Last 6 hours` and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox — verified by reloading the dashboard with no query params, after which the top bar reads "Time range selected: Last 6 hours" and the URL settles to `?from=now-6h&to=now`.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval set to `1m` and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox. Verified after a parameter-free reload: the refresh control's accessible name reads "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected" and displays `1m`; the URL settles to include `refresh=1m`.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's page URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyruizwte8lce/evgr1off-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m` — dashboard UID: `efyruizwte8lce`.

Final state check confirmed everything is saved: 0 dirty/unsaved elements in the DOM, no discard prompt when exiting edit mode, both panels present, tag `bench`, 6-hour range, and `1m` refresh all persisted.
